title: Plan single-column GROUP BY COUNT direct scan
problem: Simple SELECT column, COUNT(*) FROM table GROUP BY column still materializes full rows and runs generic GROUP BY aggregation despite only needing one decoded column and integer counters.
approach: Detect one-table, one-column GROUP BY COUNT(*) queries without WHERE, JOIN, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT, or OFFSET.
Resolve the grouping column once against the schema.
Scan rows and decode only the grouping column with RowDecoder::decode_column.
Maintain HashMap<Value, i64> counters and return grouped rows directly.
risk_controls: Keep grouped SUM/AVG and GROUP BY with HAVING/ORDER BY on the generic path.
Add SQL integration coverage for alias and NULL grouping semantics.
